name: KS Voskresensk to KRP-11 Gas Pipeline

values.PipelineName: KS Voskresensk to KRP-11 Gas Pipeline
values.RouteType: Not mapped (but could be — route or endpoints are known)
values.RouteNotes: No official GIS route. OSM seed trace (osm:voskresensk-krp-11) shares ways with the KRP-16 feeder; geometry must be separated by hand before any route is drawn.

researcher_notes: NOT a match to any GEM row. Checked: P0793 Stavropol-Moscow (retired, 1262 km, ends Moscow, feeds Serpukhov side), P2291 CAC-2 (ends at Voskresensk; this line starts there), P2321 Kasimovskoye UGS-KS Voskresensk (ends Voskresensk), P2380 KGMO ring (365 km, ring itself); none is a Voskresensk-to-Leninsky-district radial. Evidence: (1) Moscow govt decree 741-PP of 24.08.2010 (scheme, Garant, lapsed) Table 6.1 'Technical parameters of supply pipelines KGMO-KRP': KRP-11 98.6 km, DN1020; text: KS Voskresensk supplies KRP-11, 16, 15; KRP-11 gets gas by a single DN1020 string; KRP-11 in service since 1957 (Table 1.4). (2) Gazprom transgaz Moskva / Gazprom tsentrremont 2015 reporting on KRP-16 reconstruction (kadastra.net portfolio page; Wayback copy of moskva-tr.gazprom.ru news 2015/02/80 - live gazprom hosts time out from this network) names the line explicitly as 'MG Voskresensk - KRP-11' and says a second DN1000 inlet of 660 m (5.4 MPa) to KRP-16 was built off it in 2015, so the line physically exists and was in service in 2015; independent publishers/dates from the 2010 decree. Threshold: sponsor/operator Gazprom transgaz Moskva (not entered as Owner - no ref states ownership of this line; entity_lookup found no matching entity, only unrelated 'Transgaz'); endpoints KS Voskresensk to KRP-11; built/operating line never captured by GEM; length 98.6 km sourced (>=25 km). CAVEATS: (a) the 2019 Moscow scheme (decree 408-PP, garant 49556266) lists eight sources KRP-10,13,14,15,16,17,20,21 and no KRP-11, and a search snippet (not confirmed in any fetched page) says the KRP-16 reconstruction let KRP-11 be taken out of service and liquidated; so the KRP-11 terminus may no longer exist and the line may now only feed KRP-16 via the 2015 tie-in - reviewer should treat Status operating as medium confidence and consider whether the End should be the KRP-16 tie-in; (b) 98.6 km comes from the lapsed 2010 scheme only; (c) KRP-16 feeder (87.8 km, slug ks-voskresensk-krp-16) is a sibling that shares a corridor/OSM ways, adjudicate the two together to avoid double-counting. No capacity, owner, start year (1957 is KRP-11 commissioning, not the pipe), or cost filled. Tier medium: single decree for length, 2015 corroboration of existence not of length.
